name: What is involved in the design-build process for a new garage or garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the design-build process for a new garage or garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our integrated design-build process for garage construction begins with a comprehensive consultation to understand your vision and requirements. This leads to concept development, architectural planning, and detailed CAD-supported layouts. We then coordinate all necessary permits, manage construction, and oversee the selection and installation of finishes. This single point of coordination ensures clear communication and a streamlined process from concept to completion, minimizing complexities often associated with managing multiple vendors. We guide you through each phase, making the homeowner experience central to our approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our design-build process for a new garage or conversion includes consultation, architectural planning, permit coordination, construction management, and finish selection, all under one accountable team.
